interface.shortDescription: Give AI agents 30,000+ safe, token-optimized actions across Workday, SAP, Oracle + hundreds more.
interface.longDescription: StackOne is the AI Agent Integration Platform. Give your agents 30,000+ actions across Workday, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Salesforce, Google, Microsoft, and hundreds more connectors, so they can execute entire workflows reliably. Tool calling is safe and token-optimized: Defender, StackOne's safety model, screens every call in real time; Advanced Tool Search (ranked #1 for tool search accuracy on public benchmarks) and StackOne Query keep token usage and latency low. StackOne handles authentication, rate limiting, and multi-tenancy across every connector.
